patch_description: The current local search only performs adjacent swaps, which gets stuck in poor local minima quickly. A 2-opt style local search with in-place apply/undo of segment reversals explores a much larger neighborhood of orderings at low constant overhead (no full candidate list copies), enabling more improvement rounds within the same time budget. We replace the adjacent-swap local search with an in-place pairwise-swap (2-opt) search and apply it to every greedy restart's result (keeping the best), rather than only the single best greedy schedule. This combines stronger local optimization with more diverse starting points, directly lowering makespan.
